title: Veteran Capital Protocol v0.1
description: A portable, model-agnostic artifact that encodes a firm's accumulated AI judgment (its token capital) independently of any base model. Hand this file to any generalist model and the company-veteran expertise comes with it. This is the sovereignty object: the thing a firm owns, versions, and audits, and the thing it must not lose when it swaps out a base model.

domain.description: The judgment task this veteran is calibrated for, e.g. 'bvf-pillar-derivation'.

base_model_fit_on.description: The base model whose outputs the calibration policy was fit against. Informational only: the artifact is intended to lift any base model (the Veteran Test).

institutional_memory.description: The queryable knowledge base: firm notes plus high-reward exemplars accumulated by the learning loop. Token capital in its retrievable form.

notes.description: Durable, human-authored or distilled firm rules (e.g. 'ceremonial regulatory keywords should not inflate governance_risk').

exemplars.description: Past traces whose reward exceeded the promotion threshold. Retrieved as in-context guidance for similar new cases.

calibration_policy.description: The learned, model-external adjustment layer. Plain numeric parameters, not model weights. For each business outcome (pillar) it maps firm-specific features to a correction applied on top of the base model's derivation. This is the learned core of token capital and the reason expertise survives a model swap.

kind.description: Policy family. v0 ships a transparent ridge-linear residual model; the interface admits richer families without changing the artifact shape.

feature_names.description: Ordered firm-feature names. The feature vector is reproducible from a candidate via the documented featuriser.

feature_mean.description: Per-feature mean used to standardise inputs before applying weights (aligned to feature_names; index 0 is the bias identity).

feature_std.description: Per-feature standard deviation used to standardise inputs before applying weights (aligned to feature_names; index 0 is the bias identity).

weights.description: Per-target weight vectors. Each key is a business-outcome target (pillar); each value is a weight vector aligned to feature_names.

eval_suite.description: The firm's PRIVATE evals: held-out cases scored against business outcomes the firm defines, not public benchmarks. Travels inside the artifact so sovereignty is testable anywhere.

reward_spec.description: How a derivation is scored against the firm's gold judgment.

holdout_case_ids.description: Case ids reserved for evaluation and never used to fit the policy.

provenance.description: The compounding record: how this veteran was built and how its private-eval score moved over loop iterations. The audit trail of token capital.

iterations.description: Number of completed learning-loop iterations encoded in this artifact.

reward_history.description: Mean private-eval reward after each iteration. A rising series is the hill-climb.
